overview: The Land's End Hotel sits at Land's End, at the far western tip of Cornwall, a short drive from Sennen Cove. Alongside the main hotel, the same operator offers Penwith Studios and The Saddle & Stablerooms, a more rustic countryside option. Food is available at The Land's End Restaurant and the First & Last Inn.
surfTripFit: It is close to Sennen, Cornwall's most consistent surf beach, but the site gives no beach distance or surf-related facilities, so it suits a sightseeing-led trip more than a dedicated surf stay.
